description:
## [0.0.17](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.16...v0.0.17) (2026-10-28)

### Features

* **Instagram - Keep your place in Home:** New switch under Feed. Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away. Instagram no longer reloads it or resets the app to the top. Pull down still refreshes. Starts off. Asked for in #354.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** `Hide the tab bar as you scroll` works with the glass off too. Scroll down and Instagram's own bar slides away while the page fills its space. Scroll up and it's back. Reels keep their bar. Asked for in #343.
* **Instagram - Rounded post corners:** `Rounded corners on Reels` under Feed rounds a reel's video in the Reels tab and full screen, at the same Corner size. The seek bar, captions and buttons stay whole. Starts off. Asked for in #362.
* **Instagram - Rounded post corners:** `Rounded corners on stories` under Feed rounds a story's photo or video, whether it opens from the tray, a profile or a highlight, at the same Corner size. The progress bar, names and stickers stay whole. Starts off. Asked for in #363 and #368.
* **Instagram - Rounded post corners:** `Peek at the next carousel page` under Feed sits each carousel page in from the edges, with the start of the next page showing at the right. Starts off. Asked for in #361.
* **Instagram - Thicker story progress bar:** new patch. `Thicker story progress bar` under Stories draws the bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing don't change. Starts off. Asked for in #360.
* **Instagram - Start reels with sound:** new patch. `Start reels with sound` under Playback plays a reel you tap open from a post on Home with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Starts off. Asked for in #342.
* **Instagram - Pick the app icon:** `App icon` adds Instagram in black on white, a white icon with Instagram's glyph in black. Themed icons still show Instagram's glyph. Asked for in #353.
* **Instagram - Tab bar layout:** new patch. `Tab bar layout` under Tab bar keeps the newer bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, even when Instagram switches your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Asked for in #356.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` under Messages opens your hidden chats from two quick taps on the Messages button, after the lock when one's on. One tap still opens Messages. Starts off. Asked for in #358.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** A build without Pure black dark mode now says under Layout how to get it: pick it in Morphe Manager next time you patch. Searching settings for "amoled" or "oled" finds it too. Asked for in #359.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** `Choose a folder` under Downloads sends every photo and video to a folder you pick, a hidden one too, and it works on Android 9 without the storage permission. `Use Movies and Pictures` puts saves back. Asked for in #333.
* **Instagram - Seek bar on stories:** new patch. `Seek bar on stories` under Stories puts a bar near the bottom of a video story. Drag it to jump anywhere in the video and the story plays on from there. Starts off. Asked for in #355.
* **Instagram - Swipe through a chat's reels:** new patch. With `Swipe through a chat's reels` on under Messages, swiping up on a reel opened from a chat goes through the chat's other shared reels before any suggested ones. Starts off. Asked for in #350.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested stories:** `Filter the Stories tray by verified accounts` under Stories keeps only verified accounts in the row at the top of Home, or only the ones that aren't. Your own story stays. Starts off. Asked for in #340.

### Bug Fixes

* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** On your Following list, Doesn't follow you now comes before the name. A long name used to push it off the end of the line. Reported in #351.
* **Instagram:** `Hide the emoji row` and `Hide Follow on posts` now work the moment you switch them on. Before, nothing changed until you left Instagram and came back.
* **Instagram:** `Hide suggested stories` adds `Keep the Stories tray in the feed` under Stories. On some accounts the row floated over Home mid-feed and stayed put while posts scrolled under it. Now it stays in the feed. Starts off. Reported in #357.
* **Instagram:** Morphe Manager now knows the armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64 builds of Instagram too, so an older 32-bit phone is pointed at the build it can install instead of the arm64 one. Reported in #346.
* **Instagram:** `Glass tab bar` no longer leaves a dark band under a reel opened from the feed, where Instagram hides the tab bar. Reels opened from the Reels tab still stop above the bar. Reported in #347.
* **Instagram:** `Start stories with sound` turns Instagram's sound back off when you leave a story, so Feed and Reels stay muted. Coming back to the story turns it on again, and a story you muted yourself stays muted. Reported in #342.
* **Instagram:** `Download any story` also adds Download to the menu of your own highlights, which Instagram builds differently from other story menus. Reported in #339.
* **Instagram:** `Hide Follow on feed posts` also filters Subscribe before the feed header builds it. The author's name, time and menu keep their native paths.
* **Instagram:** `Tap to play` keeps a Reels auto-scroll allowance for the next Reel. Feed and unidentified players can't spend it, and a real tap on Feed still works.
* **Instagram:** `Group Instagram's notifications` keeps summaries while their notifications remain. Turning grouping off or removing one notification no longer dismisses the others. Pending posts stay protected while Android catches up. One notification uses the singular count label.
* **Instagram:** Turning off profile posts as a list, or pausing HushGram, cancels an automatic opening that was still waiting for the grid.
* **Instagram:** Canceling a download can finish while DNS, proxy discovery or response setup is still waiting. Late responses can't write a file, and repeated cancellations keep a bounded number of workers.
* **Instagram:** The downloader closes opened response streams on success and failure. Cache bytes stay only after a successful close.
* **Instagram:** Closing `Save profile picture` stops its fetch even when the general background workers are busy.
* **Instagram:** `Download any video` adds source metadata to JPEG photos saved through Save all and Choose pages, as it does for a single photo. Videos and other image formats stay unchanged.
* **Instagram:** Download history repairs a partially written record before its next write. Later saves remain listed after a restart.
* **Instagram:** A failed PIN save keeps the setup form open and reports the failure. The PIN and its retry counters are saved together.
* **Instagram:** PIN retry limits still apply in the current process when their counters can't be saved.
* **Instagram:** `HushGram settings` saves a timed lock and its wait together. Lock, unlock and wait actions no longer report success after a failed write.
* **Instagram:** `HushGram settings` checks the current lock before an editor or delayed action saves. Imports and Undo check again at their write boundary, and a held Undo remains available until its original deadline.
* **Instagram:** Font imports finish reading and closing their provider before replacing a live font. Failed or stale imports leave the current files alone, and reopening settings can't start a competing copy.
* **Instagram:** Replacing an imported app font keeps Restart now available even when the font choice hasn't changed.
* **Instagram:** Settings backups restore large selections of hidden Instagram settings rows. Selecting all 161 supported rows no longer causes that choice to be skipped.
* **Instagram:** `Hide suggested posts` keeps native paging when a filtered page retains a real post, even before its list is displayed. Header-only pages can still finish.
* **Instagram:** `Glass tab bar` blur recovers after a temporary capture failure on a still screen. Automatic retries stay bounded, and pending work stops when the bar leaves or HushGram pauses.
* **Instagram:** `Story text fonts` puts local fonts before Instagram's paid section, so selecting one doesn't open a Plus offer. Instagram's paid fonts keep their subscription checks. Reported in #275 and #325.
* **Instagram:** `View stories anonymously` keeps your own story, Create and special tray entries in their original positions during watched-story sorting. Ordinary story rings keep their order within the unseen and watched groups.
* **Instagram:** `HushGram settings` requires Android 9 on every ABI, including the two 32-bit APKs Instagram ships for Android 8. Manifest checks verify that floor and preserve any higher vendor minimum.
* **Instagram:** `Show if a profile follows you` waits for unique followers to match the account's count before recording recent unfollowers. Short lists and older queued saves can't replace a newer snapshot, and failed saves can be retried.
* **Instagram:** `HushGram settings` lets go of a closed screen or dialog. The moving title used to keep every one you'd opened in memory until Instagram restarted.
* **Instagram:** `Convert to keep the full size` asks the phone's encoder for limited range BT.709 color. Left to choose, some encoders write a file other apps show with shifted colors.
* **Tooling:** Cached patch lookups now refresh when classes are added, replaced or removed. Unchanged classes keep their cached reads.
* **Tooling:** Release walkthroughs require matching bundle, candidate and installed APK evidence, with visible content for each required destination. Incomplete receipts, changed installs and covered pages can't authorize publication.
* **Tooling:** Walk navigation checks the chosen tap point, including covers over a partly visible control. Settings labels keep their own location when a row handles the tap.
* **Tooling:** The walk accepts a loaded Explore grid under Instagram's empty Compose layer. A labeled, clickable, focusable, filled or differently built layer still counts as a cover.
* **Tooling:** The release walk expands each settings category in place and checks it folds again, since Back now closes settings. A row only counts under its own heading, and every row is checked against the settings source.
* **Tooling:** The source census keeps a relicensed source's old licence pinned and records code it took from elsewhere. InstaEclipse is GPL-3.0 now, and the HushGram downloader it carries counts as ours. Stylus dropped its Instagram patch.
* **Tooling:** The build moves to the Morphe patches plugin 2.0.0 and Kotlin 2.4.21, held to one version across the plugin's classpath. Patched apps come out the same, and the bundle carries Kotlin stdlib 2.4.21.

### Improvements

* **Instagram:** HushGram now patches Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 instead of 452.1.0.53.64. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) variant, build 385914283. The armeabi-v7a build (385914282) is declared too, and so are the x86 and x86_64 builds (385914284 and 385914285). Thanks to toidicakhia for #366.
* **Instagram:** HushGram's settings use Instagram's own blues instead of pink. Switches and buttons take its indigo button color, while icons and headings use the lighter blue Instagram gives links on a dark screen.
* **Instagram:** Every HushGram title wears Instagram's gradient now, including the settings bar, its dialogs and the lock screen. The colors drift slowly and a sheen sweeps across every few seconds, even with Android's animations turned off.
* **Instagram:** Settings categories expand their controls directly underneath. Several sections can stay open, and tapping a heading collapses it. Search finds controls across every section and restores your open sections when cleared.
* **Instagram:** Settings put switches with the screen they change. The Notifications page's suggestion switches moved to Notifications, the Reels tab's to Tab bar, and anonymous DM photos to Messages. Searching their old section still finds them.
* **Instagram:** The Updates section in settings is now called Version warnings, since all it holds is the switch for Instagram's "this version is too old" screen. Searching for Updates still finds it.
* **Instagram:** Settings open on Ads and privacy now. Settings entry moved down next to backup and the other upkeep sections, after the everyday controls.
* **Instagram:** Pause and diagnostics folds like the other sections now, so Debug logging and the report rows don't fill the overview. It opens by itself while HushGram is paused, the settings are locked or a save was interrupted.
* **Instagram:** Settings opens with Search, the list view option and a compact category list with shorter descriptions. Quick setups and the active-status banner are gone. Larger text still wraps.
* **Tooling:** The patching help explains the small-heap limit and keeps Manager's embedded VM workaround.
* **Instagram:** Download file names support `{shortcode}`, using the parent post's code for carousel pages. Unknown codes are left out. Photo names use the template when it includes that token.
* **Instagram:** `Date in backup file names` adds the local date and time to settings exports. It starts off, keeping the existing backup name until enabled.
* **Tooling:** Updated to Morphe patcher 2.0.1 and its matching Smali library. Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer is required. The dependency audit separately reviews Morphe Desktop 1.19.1.
* **Instagram:** Added Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), contributed by JhouHank in #313. Traditional Chinese script preferences and Hong Kong or Macao locales use the new table.
* **Tooling:** GitHub release notes now read like Hushfacebook's. A short summary comes first, then plain grouped bullets with no Instagram label, the update steps and what was checked.
* **Tooling:** The bundle now carries Gson 2.15.0. The patch catalog comes out byte for byte the same, and new tests hold its key order, nulls and unescaped text, including emoji.
* **Instagram:** Hide the emoji row, Hide Follow on posts, Rounded corners on Reels and Thicker story progress bar now share one check before each frame. With several on, Instagram does that work once per frame instead of once for each.

### Validation

Validation: 6891 runtime tests passed locally. All 2181 patch tests passed too.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green, teal or your wallpaper's colors (Material You, on Android 12 and newer). Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ask before a call
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons off the top of a chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ask before a like
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Ask before a refresh
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Back leaves Home
patches.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Change the like animation
patches.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons, the Friends tab and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Clear the media cache
patches.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Copy comment
patches.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Data saver
patches.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Don't report screenshots
patches.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Don't save recent searches
patches.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download voice messages
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Emoji style
patches.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Find the reel you came from
patches.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Font
patches.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Full resolution photos
patches.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide, and a third gets reel covers and grid pictures at full size. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home or your messages do. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home) and Messages (Full screen Messages).

patches.name: Glass tab bar
patches.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide Follow on feed posts
patches.description: Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide Follow on stories
patches.description: Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide Instants
patches.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off. Find them in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide highlights
patches.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide profile tabs
patches.description: Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide rows in Instagram's settings
patches.description: Lets you take the rows you don't use off Instagram's own Settings and activity screen. Open that screen once, then untick rows in HushGram settings > Layout > Rows in Instagram's settings. Every row shows to start.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the follow lists and their Suggested tab, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back, suggested threads and people, and the Featured section off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question on Home and Reels, the caught up card, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, keep only verified or unverified accounts, or hide the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide that you're typing
patches.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create, Messages and Profile, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages or Ghost mode button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches.name: Hide the Repost button
patches.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Share button
patches.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Threads button
patches.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide the comment emoji row
patches.description: Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide the home feed
patches.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the notes row
patches.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the search bar in Messages
patches.description: Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide your active status
patches.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: HushGram launch screen
patches.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: HushGram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Install next to Instagram
patches.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The second Instagram's package. Each part starts with a letter, with dots between the parts, and it can't be Instagram's own.
The name under the second Instagram's icon. It starts with a letter and holds up to 50 characters.
Puts a small HushGram badge on the second Instagram's home screen icon, so the two are easy to tell apart. Instagram's other icons you can pick in its settings get it too.

patches.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep in chat
patches.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep your place in Home
patches.description: Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away, instead of reloading it and jumping to the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Lock your messages
patches.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Long press to zoom
patches.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Loop a story
patches.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Message box buttons
patches.description: Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Open comments without the keyboard
patches.description: Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Pick the app icon
patches.description: Lets you pick the icon Instagram shows on your home screen: Instagram's own, HushGram's, or Instagram's glyph on black, on plum, or in black on white. The new icon shows once you leave Instagram, and you may need to add it to your home screen again from the app drawer. Starts on Instagram's own. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom on Reels
patches.description: Lets you zoom into a playing reel with two fingers, the way a photo zooms. Lift your fingers and it goes back. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Profile posts as a list
patches.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Version warnings.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Rounded post corners
patches.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, and of reels and stories if you like, at a small or large size. Profiles and Explore stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Save comment photo
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Save profile picture
patches.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Saved on your profile
patches.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: See who a story mentions
patches.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Seek bar on stories
patches.description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show a post's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Show a story's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show all recent searches
patches.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Show hidden like counts
patches.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Show when someone was last active
patches.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Spoof location
patches.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Start Home on Following
patches.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Start reels with sound
patches.description: A reel you open from a post on Home plays with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Start stories with sound
patches.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping for 15 minutes, and Take a scroll break covers Home, Reels and Explore for 5 minutes after the time you pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches.description: Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches.name: Stop swipe to create
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Stop swipe up to reply
patches.description: Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Story ring size
patches.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Story text fonts
patches.description: Adds fonts you pick from your phone (.ttf or .otf files) to the story text editor alongside Instagram's own fonts, and can draw the emoji in story text from an emoji font file you pick. Starts off. Set both up in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Swipe left to open the profile
patches.description: Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Swipe through a chat's reels
patches.description: Swiping up on a reel you opened from a chat goes through the other reels shared in that chat before any suggested reels, and can stop after them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Tab bar layout
patches.description: Lets you keep the newer tab bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, instead of the one Instagram picks for your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Pick one in HushGram settings > Tab bar.

patches.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Thicker story progress bar
patches.description: Draws the progress bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing stay as they were. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches.description: Sends the video stories you post at 1080p and a higher bitrate, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Instagram still shrinks story videos to 720p on its servers, so viewers see a small difference. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: View live anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

release_notes:
HushGram moves to Instagram 453.0.0.55.79, and Morphe Manager now knows all four of its builds, so 32-bit phones get pointed at the right one. Stories can play with a seek bar, a thicker progress bar and rounded corners, and reels you open from Home can start with sound. Home can keep your place when you come back, carousels can peek at the next page, and a chat's shared reels can be swiped through in a row. Settings got a new look in Instagram's blues, with sections that open in place, and there's a long list of fixes for downloads, the lock and the glass tab bar.

New in this release

- `Keep your place in Home`: New switch under Feed. Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away. Instagram no longer reloads it or resets the app to the top. Pull down still refreshes. Starts off. Asked for in #354.

- `Glass tab bar`: `Hide the tab bar as you scroll` works with the glass off too. Scroll down and Instagram's own bar slides away while the page fills its space. Scroll up and it's back. Reels keep their bar. Asked for in #343.

- `Rounded post corners`: `Rounded corners on Reels` under Feed rounds a reel's video in the Reels tab and full screen, at the same Corner size. The seek bar, captions and buttons stay whole. Starts off. Asked for in #362.

- `Rounded post corners`: `Rounded corners on stories` under Feed rounds a story's photo or video, whether it opens from the tray, a profile or a highlight, at the same Corner size. The progress bar, names and stickers stay whole. Starts off. Asked for in #363 and #368.

- `Rounded post corners`: `Peek at the next carousel page` under Feed sits each carousel page in from the edges, with the start of the next page showing at the right. Starts off. Asked for in #361.

- `Thicker story progress bar`: new patch. `Thicker story progress bar` under Stories draws the bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing don't change. Starts off. Asked for in #360.

- `Start reels with sound`: new patch. `Start reels with sound` under Playback plays a reel you tap open from a post on Home with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Starts off. Asked for in #342.

- `Pick the app icon`: `App icon` adds Instagram in black on white, a white icon with Instagram's glyph in black. Themed icons still show Instagram's glyph. Asked for in #353.

- `Tab bar layout`: new patch. `Tab bar layout` under Tab bar keeps the newer bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, even when Instagram switches your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Asked for in #356.

- `Lock your messages`: `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` under Messages opens your hidden chats from two quick taps on the Messages button, after the lock when one's on. One tap still opens Messages. Starts off. Asked for in #358.

- `HushGram settings`: A build without Pure black dark mode now says under Layout how to get it: pick it in Morphe Manager next time you patch. Searching settings for "amoled" or "oled" finds it too. Asked for in #359.

- `Download any video`: `Choose a folder` under Downloads sends every photo and video to a folder you pick, a hidden one too, and it works on Android 9 without the storage permission. `Use Movies and Pictures` puts saves back. Asked for in #333.

- `Seek bar on stories`: new patch. `Seek bar on stories` under Stories puts a bar near the bottom of a video story. Drag it to jump anywhere in the video and the story plays on from there. Starts off. Asked for in #355.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels`: new patch. With `Swipe through a chat's reels` on under Messages, swiping up on a reel opened from a chat goes through the chat's other shared reels before any suggested ones. Starts off. Asked for in #350.

- `Hide suggested stories`: `Filter the Stories tray by verified accounts` under Stories keeps only verified accounts in the row at the top of Home, or only the ones that aren't. Your own story stays. Starts off. Asked for in #340.

Fixes

- `Show if a profile follows you`: On your Following list, Doesn't follow you now comes before the name. A long name used to push it off the end of the line. Reported in #351.

- `Hide the emoji row` and `Hide Follow on posts` now work the moment you switch them on. Before, nothing changed until you left Instagram and came back.

- `Hide suggested stories` adds `Keep the Stories tray in the feed` under Stories. On some accounts the row floated over Home mid-feed and stayed put while posts scrolled under it. Now it stays in the feed. Starts off. Reported in #357.

- Morphe Manager now knows the armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64 builds of Instagram too, so an older 32-bit phone is pointed at the build it can install instead of the arm64 one. Reported in #346.

- `Glass tab bar` no longer leaves a dark band under a reel opened from the feed, where Instagram hides the tab bar. Reels opened from the Reels tab still stop above the bar. Reported in #347.

- `Start stories with sound` turns Instagram's sound back off when you leave a story, so Feed and Reels stay muted. Coming back to the story turns it on again, and a story you muted yourself stays muted. Reported in #342.

- `Download any story` also adds Download to the menu of your own highlights, which Instagram builds differently from other story menus. Reported in #339.

- `Hide Follow on feed posts` also filters Subscribe before the feed header builds it. The author's name, time and menu keep their native paths.

- `Tap to play` keeps a Reels auto-scroll allowance for the next Reel. Feed and unidentified players can't spend it, and a real tap on Feed still works.

- `Group Instagram's notifications` keeps summaries while their notifications remain. Turning grouping off or removing one notification no longer dismisses the others. Pending posts stay protected while Android catches up. One notification uses the singular count label.

- Turning off profile posts as a list, or pausing HushGram, cancels an automatic opening that was still waiting for the grid.

- Canceling a download can finish while DNS, proxy discovery or response setup is still waiting. Late responses can't write a file, and repeated cancellations keep a bounded number of workers.

- The downloader closes opened response streams on success and failure. Cache bytes stay only after a successful close.

- Closing `Save profile picture` stops its fetch even when the general background workers are busy.

- `Download any video` adds source metadata to JPEG photos saved through Save all and Choose pages, as it does for a single photo. Videos and other image formats stay unchanged.

- Download history repairs a partially written record before its next write. Later saves remain listed after a restart.

- A failed PIN save keeps the setup form open and reports the failure. The PIN and its retry counters are saved together.

- PIN retry limits still apply in the current process when their counters can't be saved.

- `HushGram settings` saves a timed lock and its wait together. Lock, unlock and wait actions no longer report success after a failed write.

- `HushGram settings` checks the current lock before an editor or delayed action saves. Imports and Undo check again at their write boundary, and a held Undo remains available until its original deadline.

- Font imports finish reading and closing their provider before replacing a live font. Failed or stale imports leave the current files alone, and reopening settings can't start a competing copy.

- Replacing an imported app font keeps Restart now available even when the font choice hasn't changed.

- Settings backups restore large selections of hidden Instagram settings rows. Selecting all 161 supported rows no longer causes that choice to be skipped.

- `Hide suggested posts` keeps native paging when a filtered page retains a real post, even before its list is displayed. Header-only pages can still finish.

- `Glass tab bar` blur recovers after a temporary capture failure on a still screen. Automatic retries stay bounded, and pending work stops when the bar leaves or HushGram pauses.

- `Story text fonts` puts local fonts before Instagram's paid section, so selecting one doesn't open a Plus offer. Instagram's paid fonts keep their subscription checks. Reported in #275 and #325.

- `View stories anonymously` keeps your own story, Create and special tray entries in their original positions during watched-story sorting. Ordinary story rings keep their order within the unseen and watched groups.

- `HushGram settings` requires Android 9 on every ABI, including the two 32-bit APKs Instagram ships for Android 8. Manifest checks verify that floor and preserve any higher vendor minimum.

- `Show if a profile follows you` waits for unique followers to match the account's count before recording recent unfollowers. Short lists and older queued saves can't replace a newer snapshot, and failed saves can be retried.

- `HushGram settings` lets go of a closed screen or dialog. The moving title used to keep every one you'd opened in memory until Instagram restarted.

- `Convert to keep the full size` asks the phone's encoder for limited range BT.709 color. Left to choose, some encoders write a file other apps show with shifted colors.

Other changes

- HushGram now patches Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 instead of 452.1.0.53.64. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) variant, build 385914283. The armeabi-v7a build (385914282) is declared too, and so are the x86 and x86_64 builds (385914284 and 385914285). Thanks to toidicakhia for #366.

- HushGram's settings use Instagram's own blues instead of pink. Switches and buttons take its indigo button color, while icons and headings use the lighter blue Instagram gives links on a dark screen.

- Every HushGram title wears Instagram's gradient now, including the settings bar, its dialogs and the lock screen. The colors drift slowly and a sheen sweeps across every few seconds, even with Android's animations turned off.

- Settings categories expand their controls directly underneath. Several sections can stay open, and tapping a heading collapses it. Search finds controls across every section and restores your open sections when cleared.

- Settings put switches with the screen they change. The Notifications page's suggestion switches moved to Notifications, the Reels tab's to Tab bar, and anonymous DM photos to Messages. Searching their old section still finds them.

- The Updates section in settings is now called Version warnings, since all it holds is the switch for Instagram's "this version is too old" screen. Searching for Updates still finds it.

- Settings open on Ads and privacy now. Settings entry moved down next to backup and the other upkeep sections, after the everyday controls.

- Pause and diagnostics folds like the other sections now, so Debug logging and the report rows don't fill the overview. It opens by itself while HushGram is paused, the settings are locked or a save was interrupted.

- Settings opens with Search, the list view option and a compact category list with shorter descriptions. Quick setups and the active-status banner are gone. Larger text still wraps.

- Download file names support `{shortcode}`, using the parent post's code for carousel pages. Unknown codes are left out. Photo names use the template when it includes that token.

- `Date in backup file names` adds the local date and time to settings exports. It starts off, keeping the existing backup name until enabled.

- Added Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), contributed by JhouHank in #313. Traditional Chinese script preferences and Hong Kong or Macao locales use the new table.

- Hide the emoji row, Hide Follow on posts, Rounded corners on Reels and Thicker story progress bar now share one check before each frame. With several on, Instagram does that work once per frame instead of once for each.

Behind the scenes

- Cached patch lookups now refresh when classes are added, replaced or removed. Unchanged classes keep their cached reads.

- Release walkthroughs require matching bundle, candidate and installed APK evidence, with visible content for each required destination. Incomplete receipts, changed installs and covered pages can't authorize publication.

- Walk navigation checks the chosen tap point, including covers over a partly visible control. Settings labels keep their own location when a row handles the tap.

- The walk accepts a loaded Explore grid under Instagram's empty Compose layer. A labeled, clickable, focusable, filled or differently built layer still counts as a cover.

- The release walk expands each settings category in place and checks it folds again, since Back now closes settings. A row only counts under its own heading, and every row is checked against the settings source.

- The source census keeps a relicensed source's old licence pinned and records code it took from elsewhere. InstaEclipse is GPL-3.0 now, and the HushGram downloader it carries counts as ours. Stylus dropped its Instagram patch.

- The build moves to the Morphe patches plugin 2.0.0 and Kotlin 2.4.21, held to one version across the plugin's classpath. Patched apps come out the same, and the bundle carries Kotlin stdlib 2.4.21.

- The patching help explains the small-heap limit and keeps Manager's embedded VM workaround.

- Updated to Morphe patcher 2.0.1 and its matching Smali library. Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer is required. The dependency audit separately reviews Morphe Desktop 1.19.1.

- GitHub release notes now read like Hushfacebook's. A short summary comes first, then plain grouped bullets with no Instagram label, the update steps and what was checked.

- The bundle now carries Gson 2.15.0. The patch catalog comes out byte for byte the same, and new tests hold its key order, nulls and unescaped text, including emoji.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.2.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `453.0.0.55.79`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

6891 runtime tests passed locally. All 2181 patch tests passed too.

All four Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 builds took 122 of the 123 patches, everything but Install next to Instagram, which makes a second app. I patched Instagram with this exact bundle and walked the whole app on an emulator: the feed, Explore, Reels, the inbox, a profile and every section of HushGram's settings, 29 screens in all, and Instagram didn't crash once.
